title: Lion cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='32' fill='#c96a1e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='28' fill='#e8913a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='24' r='9' fill='#e8913a'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='24' r='5' fill='#f7c07a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='24' r='9' fill='#e8913a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='24' r='5' fill='#f7c07a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='24' fill='#f7c07a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='4' fill='#5c3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='4' fill='#5c3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='40.5' r='1.4' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='40.5' r='1.4' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <!-- nose and muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#fbe0b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='3' ry='2.4' fill='#c96a1e'/>
  <path d='M50 51.5 Q46 56 44 54 M50 51.5 Q54 56 56 54' stroke='#c96a1e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#f7c07a'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#fbe0b8'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='76' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#f7c07a' transform='rotate(20 33 76)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='64' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#f7c07a' transform='rotate(-35 69 64)'/>
  <!-- paw pad on waving arm -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='56' r='5' fill='#fbe0b8'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='54' r='1.3' fill='#e8913a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='52.5' r='1.3' fill='#e8913a'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='54' r='1.3' fill='#e8913a'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='94' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f7c07a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f7c07a'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='94' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#fbe0b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#fbe0b8'/>
</svg>
